### Universal bg-white applied instead of per-asset conditional backgrounds **High Severity** The PR description states it "narrows to the mobile algorithm" with per-asset background handling (`ASSETS_REQUIRING_LIGHT_BG` for dark mode, `ASSETS_REQUIRING_DARK_BG` for light mode), but the code applies `bg-white` unconditionally to every token via `twMerge('bg-white', className)`. Neither `ASSETS_REQUIRING_LIGHT_BG` nor `ASSETS_REQUIRING_DARK_BG` exist anywhere in the codebase. Tokens with white/light logos (S, RESOLV, IO, SOPH per the description) will be invisible against the white background, especially in light mode — the exact regression the PR says it fixes.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 82e59e6aad9904491a15a36ce968b7cdafe34cc7. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).
Fixed in 4fe690fef2. Restored per-asset background handling so assets requiring light backgrounds get bg-white in dark mode, and assets requiring dark backgrounds get bg-icon-default in light mode.

Fixed in 0ad852a4326102a92c3338c164e837a583de7c50. Per-asset theme handling is preserved so only assets requiring light backgrounds get bg-white in dark mode and unaffected assets keep the default avatar background.

### Deep merge replaced with shallow spread loses accumulated properties **High Severity** Replacing lodash `merge({}, additionalFragmentProps, fragment)` with a shallow spread `{...additionalFragmentProps, ...fragment}` silently drops accumulated nested `properties` and `sensitiveProperties` from existing event fragments. The existing test fixtures confirm both the accumulated fragment and the new fragment carry nested `properties` objects — `merge` deep-merges them, but the spread causes the new fragment's `properties` to completely overwrite the accumulated ones. This loses transaction metrics data that was deliberately accumulated via `updateEventFragment` for the "Transaction Submitted" event. The test at line 367 still computes expected values using `merge()`, confirming the intended behavior is deep merge.
 
Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 4fe690fef28c7ed3ee66631a34aed07e805ec29a. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).
Fixed in 218530c3e66eeaedf948fef343018638e28a5b8d. Restored lodash deep merge so accumulated nested MetaMetrics fragment properties are preserved.
Fixed in 0ad852a4326102a92c3338c164e837a583de7c50. The submitted transaction fragment path keeps lodash deep merge semantics so nested accumulated properties are preserved.

### RESOLV and USUAL duplicated across both background sets **Medium Severity** `RESOLV` and `USUAL` appear in both `ASSETS_REQUIRING_LIGHT_BG` and `ASSETS_REQUIRING_DARK_BG`. This causes these tokens to receive a forced background override in every theme (white bg in dark mode, dark bg in light mode), meaning they never use the default avatar background. The PR description lists `RESOLV` only as a dark-bg example, suggesting its presence in the light-bg set is unintentional. If a token truly needs overrides in both themes, it warrants a comment; otherwise the duplicates likely indicate a copy-paste error from the mobile config.
